relationship_description: Father-son, Amado Jr. was Governor (2007-2016) and Representative, Amado III 'Pogi' is current Governor of Pangasinan (2019-present, re-elected 2022)
Father-in-law and daughter-in-law, Priscilla 'Mely' is wife of Amado III and Mayor of Bugallon
Father-son, Jumel Anthony was Mayor of Bugallon and is now Representative of Pangasinan 2nd District (2019-present)
Married couple, Amado III is Governor, Priscilla succeeded their son as Mayor of Bugallon
Brothers, Amado III is Governor, Jumel is Representative
Mother-son, Priscilla succeeded Jumel as Mayor of Bugallon when he ran for Congress
Father-daughter (likely), Manuel was Governor, Julie (Joy) Ortega ran for 1st District Representative in 2025 and is Provincial Board Member
Father-son, Manuel was Governor, Francisco III (Kiko) was Governor and ran for 2nd District Representative in 2025
Father-son, Manuel was Governor, Mannix ran for San Fernando City Mayor in 2025
Father-daughter, Francisco III was Governor, Raphaelle 'Rafy' was first female Governor of La Union (2022-2025) but lost re-election to granduncle Mario
Granduncle-grandniece, Mario defeated Raphaelle in 2025 gubernatorial race, now Governor (2025-present)
Father-daughter, Mario is Governor, Danielle won San Fernando City Council seat in 2025
Father-son, Pablo is Vice Mayor of San Fernando City, Paolo is Representative of La Union 1st District (2022-present) and Deputy Speaker
Married couple, Pablo is Vice Mayor, Mariquita won as Mayor of San Juan town in 2025
Cousins, Paolo defeated Julie (Joy) in 2025 1st District Representative race (Paolo 131,305 votes, Joy 45,554 votes)
